source:
Yuusuke is an ordinary convenience store clerk. Ordinary except that he's a huge lolicon. After work he finds Lily, a little girl with wings on her back passed out in the alley behind his work. She hits all of his strike zones, a perfect loli body. Fearful yet not willing to pass up the chance he picks her up and rushes home.
